ROE/ROIC are now BELOW the 11.5% risk-free rate -- the earning power no longer clears the bar a quality holding should. Despite this, CPHL trades at the richest P/E of the three pharma holdings (18.5x vs SEARL 11.3x, GLAXO 9.5x) -- the market isn't pricing the deterioration in. One down year with a weakening balance sheet, priced at a premium multiple, is enough to trim -- not yet the multi-quarter break that would justify a full EXIT.
